headline: Mastercard says an AI agent booked and paid for a live flight
body: Mastercard says an AI travel agent searched, booked, paid for and ticketed a live flight without the agent ever seeing the card number. The effort combined Mastercard’s payment network with Travelport, Booked AI and Basis Theory, and the airline remained the merchant throughout the transaction.
note: For airlines, the point Mastercard makes is that they can sell through AI agents while keeping control of how they are paid.

evidence.text: Mastercard has teamed with a trio of payments and travel companies to complete a live, end-to-end, artificial intelligence-powered travel purchase.

This effort, announced Thursday (Nov. 12), combined Mastercard’s payment network with Travelport’s travel retailing and connectivity, Booked AI’s conversational travel platform, and Basis Theory’s payment vault.

“Through the collaboration, an AI travel agent searched, booked, paid for and ticketed a live flight without the customer leaving the conversation, and without the agent ever seeing the underlying card number,” Mastercard said in a news release.
Mastercard Agent Pay initiated payment with a secure tokenized credential, with the underlying card credential held in Basis Theory’s PCI-compliant vault.

Mastercard also stressed the importance of the fact that the airline “remained the merchant” throughout this transaction, and that processing “the payment itself with no intermediary checkout in between, demonstrating that airlines can sell through AI agents while keeping control of how they are paid.”
